title: My partner says I start fighting him when I have the "running" mallworld dreams.
content: The times I'm running in the hospital or through the woods on the dirt trails, I guess my body gets violent in real life. My boyfriend says that I start headbutting and thrashing or going into a tiny ball and he can't unravel me from the ball. I will also start talking and saying mumbles that sound somewhat angry or like im fighting someone. Usually when I wake up, I'll tell him all about the dream and the details. What's funny is sometimes I wasnt actually fighting physically in mallworld, but just arguing or running instead of throwing headbutts.
